description: A short paragraph a job seeker in Finland can give an employer to bring up a wage subsidy (palkkatuki), in Finnish, Swedish or English, with the reminder that the subsidy is agreed with the employment services before the contract is signed. eligible is false when the planned start date is today or earlier. The employment services decide the subsidy; the paragraph is not a promise. Reuse: figures may be quoted with a visible link to the jobcrawls.com page in the result (or "JobCrawls (jobcrawls.com)" where a link is impossible); each result repeats this in dataUse.
